urn:uuid:fb953db8-aec6-5a31-becd-b4e98ae.title: Deterministic Pixels
urn:uuid:fb953db8-aec6-5a31-becd-b4e98ae.summary: I’ve always liked identicons, which WordPress and GitHub have used to great effect. The premise is simple: take a user identifier such as an IP or email address and deterministically convert it into an image based on a simple algorithm. To that I end I started hacking on Identikon - a little Racket program that generates different types of identicons based on rules modules.
